tasks.description:
Define and document the core project team structure as specified in the requirements. The project requires a team of 4-5 people with specific role allocations: 1 Product Manager, 1 Technical Lead, 2 Backend/CLI Developers, and 1 Quality Assurance engineer.

This task involves formalizing the team hierarchy, establishing reporting relationships, and documenting the organizational structure that will support the MVP development effort. The structure must be documented in a format accessible to all stakeholders.

The team structure serves as the foundation for role assignment, resource allocation, and project execution planning.
tasks.task_notes: This is a foundational task that should be completed early as other tasks depend on having clear team structure. Consider documenting the team structure in a format that can be easily shared (e.g., Markdown, diagram tool, or project management system).

requirement_snippets:
### **6.1 Core Team Structure**
```
Project Team (4-5 people)
├── Product Manager (1)
├── Technical Lead (1)
├── Backend/CLI Developer (2)
└── Quality Assurance (1)
```
constraints: Must include exactly 1 Quality Assurance engineer
success_criteria: Team structure is documented with all 5 specified roles
Team size is within 4-5 person range
Organizational hierarchy is clearly defined

tasks.task_name: Define Product Manager role responsibilities and deliverables
tasks.description:
Document the complete Product Manager role definition including all responsibilities and MVP deliverables as specified in section 6.2.1 of the requirements.

The Product Manager is responsible for defining and prioritizing the feature roadmap, gathering user requirements and feedback, coordinating between stakeholders and the development team, managing project timeline and milestones, ensuring business requirements are met, and creating user documentation and marketing materials.

For the MVP phase, the Product Manager must deliver: user stories and acceptance criteria, MVP scope definition, user testing plan, and go-to-market strategy for the CLI tool. This documentation will serve as the reference for role expectations and performance evaluation.
tasks.task_notes: This role definition should be detailed enough to use for hiring, onboarding, or assigning responsibilities. Consider including examples or templates for key deliverables like user stories format and MVP scope documentation structure.

requirement_snippets:
#### **6.2.1 Product Manager**
**Responsibilities:**
- Define and prioritize feature roadmap
- Gather user requirements and feedback
- Coordinate between stakeholders and development team
- Manage project timeline and milestones
- Ensure business requirements are met
- User documentation and marketing materials

**MVP Deliverables:**
- User stories and acceptance criteria
- MVP scope definition
- User testing plan
- Go-to-market strategy for CLI tool
success_criteria: User stories and acceptance criteria are delivered
MVP scope definition is completed
User testing plan is documented
Go-to-market strategy for CLI tool is defined
All 6 core responsibilities are clearly documented
Documentation is accessible to all stakeholders

tasks.task_name: Define Technical Lead role responsibilities and deliverables
tasks.description:
Document the complete Technical Lead role definition including all responsibilities as specified in section 6.2.2 of the requirements.

The Technical Lead is responsible for architecture design and technical decisions, code review and quality standards, implementation of core modules, integration with Notion API, performance and security oversight, and mentoring other developers.

This role is critical for ensuring technical quality and consistency across the project. The documentation should clarify the authority and decision-making scope of the Technical Lead, particularly regarding architectural choices, code standards, and integration strategies. Since the project involves integration with Notion API, specific technical expertise in API integration should be highlighted.
tasks.task_notes: The Technical Lead role is crucial for the project's technical success. Consider documenting specific technical decision-making processes, code review guidelines, and mentoring structures. The Notion API integration responsibility suggests this role requires API integration expertise.

requirement_snippets:
#### **6.2.2 Technical Lead**
**Responsibilities:**
- Architecture design and technical decisions
- Code review and quality standards
- Implementation of core modules
- Integration with Notion API
- Performance and security oversight
- Mentoring other developers
constraints: Must address Notion API integration specifically
success_criteria: Architecture design process is documented
Code review and quality standards are established
Core modules implementation approach is defined
Notion API integration strategy is documented
Performance and security oversight processes are defined
Mentoring structure and expectations are documented
All responsibilities are clearly articulated with measurable outcomes

tasks.description:
Document the Backend/CLI Developer role definition. While the requirements specify 2 Backend/CLI Developers in the core team structure (section 6.1), detailed responsibilities for this role are not provided in the requirement chunks.

This task involves extrapolating appropriate responsibilities based on the project context (CLI tool development with Notion API integration) and ensuring consistency with the Technical Lead and Product Manager roles. The documentation should clarify how the 2 developers will collaborate, divide responsibilities, and report to the Technical Lead.

Key areas to document include: CLI tool development, backend service implementation, API integration support, unit testing, code documentation, and collaboration with QA.

tasks.task_name: Define Quality Assurance role responsibilities and deliverables
tasks.description:
Document the Quality Assurance role definition. While the requirements specify 1 Quality Assurance engineer in the core team structure (section 6.1), detailed responsibilities for this role are not provided in the requirement chunks.

This task involves defining appropriate QA responsibilities based on the project context (CLI tool with Notion API integration) and ensuring alignment with the overall team structure. The documentation should clarify the QA engineer's role in testing strategy, test planning, automated testing, manual testing, bug tracking, and collaboration with developers.

Key areas to document include: test strategy development, test case creation, automated and manual testing, integration testing (especially with Notion API), bug tracking and reporting, and user acceptance testing support.

tasks.task_name: Create consolidated team roles and responsibilities document
tasks.description:
Compile all individual role definitions into a single, comprehensive team roles and responsibilities document that serves as the authoritative reference for the project team.

This document should integrate the team structure (section 6.1) and all role definitions (section 6.2) into a cohesive format that clearly shows how the team works together, reporting relationships, collaboration points, and handoff processes.

The document should be accessible to all stakeholders and serve as a reference for onboarding, performance evaluation, and project management. It should also include a RACI matrix or similar tool to clarify decision-making authority and accountability for key project activities.
tasks.task_notes: This is an integration task that depends on completion of all individual role definition tasks. The consolidated document should be reviewed by all stakeholders and updated as the project evolves. Consider storing this in a version-controlled location.
